initial_preflight.reason: No trainable candidate in the pinned snapshot was cryptographically proven equivalent to Prime at initial preflight.

resolution.method: canonical trainable reconstruction from Prime's complete F32 GGUF tensor set followed by exact frozen-converter round trip

reason: The missing historical PyTorch checkpoint was not recovered. Instead, Prime's complete F32 GGUF tensor state was inverted into an explicitly canonical 66-entry Spark/CST trainable representation. The exact frozen converter reproduced the original Prime GGUF byte-for-byte, including all 61 tensors, tokenizer, metadata, and final SHA256. This establishes a cryptographically anchored trainable representation of Prime without claiming lost historical raw parameters or training provenance.
required_action_before_full_weight_train: Use only the canonical reconstruction artifact whose SHA256 is recorded above. Keep the original Prime GGUF immutable. Training runs must start a new descendant checkpoint identity and must not claim the canonical sigma/output-bias choices are recovered historical values. Quantum provenance remains separately gated.
